headline: Turkey's Central Bank Suspends Repo Auctions and Hikes Lira Remuneration
summary: The Central Bank of Turkey suspended its one-week repo auctions and raised the remuneration rate on required reserves for Turkish lira deposits from 86% to 90% of the weighted average funding cost.
why: Monetary policy adjustments by central banks directly influence domestic borrowing costs, banking sector margins, and currency valuation.

entities.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Tightening reserve remuneration rates impacts funding liquidity and monetary conditions.
